column1: # Server-log signatures scripts/deb-server-log-audit.sh reports as KNOWN instead of failing.
# Format: one entry per line, an extended regex (matched against the whole
# signature line the audit prints), a TAB, and the reason. The reason must
# cite a GitHub issue (#NNNN), a docs/ui-tests/app-findings-log.md finding
# ("app-findings-log.md finding N"), or the repository file that explains it
# Keep entries narrow. Anchor them, name the source location and, for
# exceptions, the first CARLOS frame or the request path: a broad entry turns
# a real regression into a KNOWN line. An entry with neither a frame nor an
# exception names its exact source line, because one class can log many
# different failures by class name alone; when the code moves, the entry
# turns UNKNOWN, which fails safe. Never add an entry to make an audit
# pass -- an unexplained ERROR is a finding first (report, don't encode).
# Provoked on purpose by checks that prove error handling or refusal:
